No data-loss or bypass path found: unmarked, foreign-marked, edited, symlinked, or non-directory plugin targets are left untouched with exit 3 before agy runs, the ownership predicate compares exact content hashes both ways, a missing receipt or any extra or missing file denies ownership, and the manifest-name check prevents replacing a differently-named plugin.
